paired_statistical_oracle.numeric_rule: Convert stored finite scalars to Python binary64. Sum floating contributions with math.fsum in matrix-column order; integer counts use unbounded integers and divide once. Compute per-UID macro ratios before resampling aggregation. Preserve all repeated records and ties.
paired_statistical_oracle.effect_definition: For every registered endpoint d=statistic_relbias-statistic_q32 and d_b is the same difference recomputed from bootstrap row b. For centered null boundary h define z_b=d_b-d+h.
paired_statistical_oracle.primary_raw_p: For both higher-is-better primary endpoints use h=0 and p=(1+count(z_b>=d))/10001. Equality is included in the upper tail; numerator and denominator are stored as exact integers.
paired_statistical_oracle.holm_p_values_only: Sort (raw_p,endpoint_id) ascending, breaking p ties lexicographically by exact endpoint ID. adjusted first=min(1,2*p1); adjusted second=max(adjusted first,p2). Map back to endpoint IDs. Both adjusted p values must be <=0.05. Holm affects p values only and never selects CI ranks or alpha levels.
paired_statistical_oracle.bonferroni_primary_CI: For each primary endpoint independently sort its 10000 paired bootstrap binary64 d_b values, retain ties, perform no interpolation, and take zero-based elements 124 and 9874. These are the simultaneous Bonferroni familywise 95% percentile bounds. Both lower bounds must be strictly >0. Holm-rank, unadjusted 2.5/97.5 percent, interpolated, basic, BCa or studentized intervals are forbidden.
paired_statistical_oracle.higher_NI: For a higher-is-better NI endpoint with positive margin m use h=-m and upper-tail p=(1+count(z_b>=d))/10001, equality included. Require p<=0.05 and observed d>-m strictly. NI p values and boundaries receive no Holm or other multiplicity adjustment.
paired_statistical_oracle.lower_NI: For a lower-is-better NI endpoint with positive margin m use h=+m and lower-tail p=(1+count(z_b<=d))/10001, equality included. Require p<=0.05 and observed d<+m strictly. NI p values and boundaries receive no Holm or other multiplicity adjustment.
paired_statistical_oracle.primary_gate: For rollout_macro_event_edge_f1 and teacher_micro_pointer_f1 separately require observed relbias-minus-q32 delta>=0.01, Bonferroni percentile lower bound>0, and Holm-adjusted p<=0.05; then require every structural, teacher NI, secondary NI, efficiency and resource guard.
